title: bounds.json
description: The spec-level bounds, published in the format-spec release; a package cannot set them.

files.description: The most files in a package, every index.json included.

fileBytes.description: The most bytes in one file, after line-ending normalisation.

totalBytes.description: The most bytes in all, uncompressed.

pathLength.description: The longest path in characters, counted from the package root.

jsonDepth.description: The deepest nesting in any JSON value.

expressionNodes.description: The most nodes in one JSON Logic expression.

sourceBounds.description: The limits on a package's source.

passes.description: The most passes of a while.

parallel.description: The most iterations of a loop in parallel.

formatBounds.description: The limits on a format's evaluation and on calls.

windowsReservedIds.description: The ids Windows reserves as file names.
